Name example: "Progódigo", "Cafelio". Implementation:

```js
function hashCode(s){let h=0;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){h=(h*31+s.charCodeAt(i))|0}return Math.abs(h)}
function synthName(a,b){
  const h=hashCode([a,b].sort().join('+'));
  const A=a.name, B=b.name;
  // take first half of A + second half of B (or vice versa by hash)
  const take = (h&1)? [A,B] : [B,A];
  const cutA=Math.max(2,Math.floor(take[0].length*0.5));
  const cutB=Math.max(2,Math.floor(take[1].length*0.5));
  let n=take[0].slice(0,cutA).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-záéíóúñü]/gi,'');
  n+=take[1].slice(-cutB).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-záéíóúñü]/gi,'');
  n=n.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+n.slice(1);
  // optional suffix from list
  const suffixes=['',' 2.0',' deluxe',' máximo',' ∞','',''];
  const suf=suffixes[h%suffixes.length];
  return (n+suf).trim();
}
```
